export type RightsDocument = RightsPolicyRevision | RightsDecision;
export const RIGHTS_POLICY_SCHEMA_SHA256 = "@@SCHEMA_SHA256@@";

const SCHEMA: unknown = @@SCHEMA_JSON@@;
type JsonRecord = Record<string, unknown>;
const FORBIDDEN = new Set(["__proto__", "constructor", "prototype"]);

function record(value: unknown): JsonRecord | null {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  if (prototype !== Object.prototype && prototype !== null) return null;
  const descriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(value);
  if (Object.keys(descriptors).length > 64 || Object.entries(descriptors).some(([key, property]) =>
    FORBIDDEN.has(key) || !("value" in property))) return null;
  return value as JsonRecord;
}

function matches(value: unknown, rawNode: unknown, depth = 0): boolean {
  if (depth > 14) return false;
  const node = record(rawNode);
  const definitions = record(record(SCHEMA)?.$defs);
  if (!node || !definitions) return false;
  if (typeof node.$ref === "string") {
    const name = node.$ref.startsWith("#/$defs/") ? node.$ref.slice(8) : "";
    return name !== "" && matches(value, definitions[name], depth + 1);
  }
  if (Object.hasOwn(node, "const") && value !== node.const) return false;
  if (Array.isArray(node.enum) && !node.enum.includes(value)) return false;
  if (Array.isArray(node.anyOf) && !node.anyOf.some((option) => matches(value, option, depth + 1))) return false;
  if (Array.isArray(node.oneOf) && node.oneOf.filter((option) => matches(value, option, depth + 1)).length !== 1) return false;
  if (node.type === "null") return value === null;
  if (node.type === "string" || typeof node.pattern === "string") {
    if (typeof value !== "string") return false;
    const scalarLength = Array.from(value).length;
    if (scalarLength > 65536) return false;
    if (typeof node.minLength === "number" && scalarLength < node.minLength) return false;
    if (typeof node.maxLength === "number" && scalarLength > node.maxLength) return false;
    if (typeof node.maxLength !== "number" && scalarLength > 256) return false;
    if (typeof node.pattern === "string") {
      const hit = new RegExp(node.pattern, "u").exec(value);
      if (!hit || hit.index !== 0 || hit[0].length !== value.length) return false;
    }
  }
  if (node.type === "integer") {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) return false;
    if (typeof node.minimum === "number" && (value as number) < node.minimum) return false;
    if (typeof node.maximum === "number" && (value as number) > node.maximum) return false;
  }
  if (node.type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean") return false;
  if (node.type === "array") {
    if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length > 256) return false;
    if (typeof node.maxItems === "number" && value.length > node.maxItems) return false;
    if (!value.every((item) => matches(item, node.items, depth + 1))) return false;
  }
  if (node.type === "object") {
    const item = record(value);
    const properties = record(node.properties);
    if (!item || !properties || !Array.isArray(node.required)) return false;
    const keys = Object.keys(item);
    if (node.additionalProperties === false && keys.some((key) => !Object.hasOwn(properties, key))) return false;
    if (!node.required.every((key) => typeof key === "string" && Object.hasOwn(item, key))) return false;
    if (!keys.every((key) => matches(item[key], properties[key], depth + 1))) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function canonicalUtcMillis(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === "string" && !value.startsWith("0000")
    && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) && new Date(value).toISOString() === value;
}

function sameSubject(first: JsonRecord, second: JsonRecord): boolean {
  for (const key of ["projectId", "sourceAssertionRevisionId", "copyId", "copyLocation", "resourceClass"])
    if (first[key] !== second[key]) return false;
  const left = record(first.address);
  const right = record(second.address);
  if (!left || !right) return false;
  return ["kind", "contextId", "revisionId", "ordinal", "recordKey"].every((key) => left[key] === right[key]);
}

function validAddress(subject: JsonRecord): boolean {
  const address = record(subject.address);
  if (!address) return false;
  if (address.kind === "import-member") return typeof address.ordinal === "number"
    && address.ordinal >= 1 && typeof address.recordKey === "string";
  return address.kind === "connector-record" && typeof address.ordinal === "number"
    && address.ordinal <= 999 && address.recordKey === null;
}

function validUse(raw: unknown): boolean {
  const use = record(raw);
  if (!use) return false;
  const action = use.action;
  const destination = use.destinationKind;
  if (["store", "inspect", "index", "derive", "quote"].includes(String(action)) && destination !== "local-project") return false;
  if (action === "model-use" && !["local-project", "remote-model"].includes(String(destination))) return false;
  if (action === "export" && !["local-export", "external-export"].includes(String(destination))) return false;
  if (action === "share" && destination !== "collaboration") return false;
  if (["remote-model", "external-export"].includes(String(destination)))
    return use.provider !== null && use.region !== null && use.shareGroup === null;
  if (destination === "collaboration")
    return use.shareGroup !== null && use.provider === null && use.region === null;
  return use.provider === null && use.region === null && use.shareGroup === null;
}

function validPermission(raw: unknown, subject: JsonRecord): boolean {
  const item = record(raw);
  const itemSubject = record(item?.subject);
  if (!item || !itemSubject || !sameSubject(subject, itemSubject) || !validUse(item.use)) return false;
  if (!canonicalUtcMillis(item.recordedAt)) return false;
  if (item.expiresAt !== null && (!canonicalUtcMillis(item.expiresAt) || item.expiresAt <= item.recordedAt)) return false;
  const evidence = item.evidenceRevisionIds;
  if (!Array.isArray(evidence) || new Set(evidence).size !== evidence.length) return false;
  if (item.value !== "unknown" && evidence.length === 0) return false;
  if (item.confirmationRequired && item.value !== "permitted") return false;
  if (item.basis === "source-observation") return item.assertedByActorId === null
    && item.entitlementRevisionId === null && ["reported", "disputed"].includes(String(item.confidence))
    && item.confirmationRequired === false;
  if (item.basis === "researcher-confirmed") return item.assertedByActorId !== null
    && item.entitlementRevisionId === null && item.confidence === "confirmed";
  return item.basis === "verified-entitlement" && item.assertedByActorId !== null
    && item.entitlementRevisionId !== null && item.confidence === "verified";
}

function validObservation(raw: unknown, subject: JsonRecord): boolean {
  if (raw === null) return true;
  const observation = record(raw);
  const source = record(observation?.address);
  const address = record(subject.address);
  const terms = record(observation?.terms);
  if (!observation || !source || !address || !terms
    || observation.projectId !== subject.projectId
    || observation.sourceAssertionRevisionId !== subject.sourceAssertionRevisionId
    || !["kind", "contextId", "revisionId", "ordinal", "recordKey"]
      .every((key) => source[key] === address[key])) return false;
  if (address.kind === "connector-record"
    && (observation.sourceRevisionId !== address.revisionId || observation.retrievedAt === null)) return false;
  if (observation.retrievedAt !== null && !canonicalUtcMillis(observation.retrievedAt)) return false;
  for (const name of ["license", "terms"]) {
    const reported = record(terms[name]);
    if (!reported || (reported.state === "reported") !== (reported.value !== null)) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function semanticError(document: JsonRecord): string | null {
  const subject = record(document.subject);
  if (!subject || !validAddress(subject)) return "rights-source-address-invalid";
  if (document.documentType === "research-observatory-rights-policy-revision") {
    if (document.revisionId === document.predecessorRevisionId) return "rights-revision-self-predecessor";
    if (!validObservation(document.sourceObservation, subject)) return "rights-observation-invalid";
    const permissions = document.permissions;
    if (!Array.isArray(permissions)) return "rights-permissions-invalid";
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    for (const permission of permissions) {
      const item = record(permission);
      if (!item || !validPermission(item, subject) || typeof item.assertionId !== "string"
        || seen.has(item.assertionId)) return "rights-permission-invalid";
      seen.add(item.assertionId);
    }
    return null;
  }
  if (document.documentType === "research-observatory-rights-decision") {
    if (!validUse(document.use) || !canonicalUtcMillis(document.evaluatedAt)) return "rights-decision-invalid";
    if (document.expiresAt !== null && !canonicalUtcMillis(document.expiresAt)) return "rights-decision-invalid";
    const ids = document.governingAssertionIds;
    if (!Array.isArray(ids) || ids.some((item, index) => index > 0 && ids[index - 1] >= item))
      return "rights-decision-invalid";
    const authority = document.authorityKind;
    if ((authority === "policy") !== (document.policyRevisionId !== null))
      return "rights-decision-invalid";
    if (authority === "legacy-import-bridge") {
      const requested = record(document.use);
      const address = record(subject.address);
      if (document.code !== "allow" || document.reasonCode !== "rights-legacy-import-confirmed"
        || ids.length !== 1 || ids[0] !== subject.sourceAssertionRevisionId
        || document.sourceAssertionSha256 === null || address?.kind !== "import-member"
        || subject.copyId !== subject.sourceAssertionRevisionId || subject.copyLocation !== "local-source"
        || subject.resourceClass !== "metadata" || !requested
        || !["store", "inspect", "derive", "index"].includes(String(requested.action))
        || requested.purpose !== "corpus-membership" || requested.destinationKind !== "local-project"
        || document.expiresAt !== null) return "rights-decision-invalid";
    }
    if (document.code === "allow" && (authority === "none" || ids.length === 0
      || (document.expiresAt !== null && document.expiresAt <= document.evaluatedAt)))
      return "rights-decision-invalid";
    return null;
  }
  return "rights-document-type-invalid";
}

export function rightsContractErrors(value: unknown): ReadonlyArray<string> {
  try {
    if (!matches(value, SCHEMA)) return Object.freeze(["rights-contract-schema-invalid"]);
    const error = semanticError(value as JsonRecord);
    return Object.freeze(error === null ? [] : [error]);
  } catch {
    return Object.freeze(["rights-contract-schema-invalid"]);
  }
}

function freezeDeep(value: unknown): void {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return;
  for (const child of Object.values(value)) freezeDeep(child);
  Object.freeze(value);
}

export function decodeRightsDocument(value: unknown): RightsDocument | null {
  if (rightsContractErrors(value).length !== 0) return null;
  try {
    const copy: unknown = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
    freezeDeep(copy);
    return copy as RightsDocument;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
